text: {"memo": "As of March 31, 2025, the most recently completed fiscal year was Costco Wholesale’s fiscal 2024, ended September 29, 2024. Revenue increased 7.8% to $242.5 billion, from $226.5 billion in fiscal 2023 and $196.0 billion in fiscal 2022; fiscal 2021 revenue was $163.5 billion. Net income rose to $5.68 billion, or $2.68 per diluted share, versus $4.57 billion, or $2.31, in fiscal 2023, and $3.56 billion, or $1.92, in fiscal 2022. Fiscal 2021 net income was $2.35 billion, or $1.59 per share. Operating cash flow remained robust at about $12.8 billion in fiscal 2024, supporting buybacks and dividends. Margins were healthy but slightly compressed versus prior peaks, while comparable sales increased modestly and membership renewal rates stayed elevated near 92%. Fiscal 2023 operating margin and EPS were impacted by inventory markdowns; prior years showed similar resilient demand. The business continues to compound at a premium multiple, though growth has decelerated from post-pandemic recovery levels. On March 31, 2025, the stock would look like a premium-quality compounder with durable cash generation, but valuation risks remain elevated. View: Hold."}
